_comment: Acknowledged price-feed gaps. build.js resolves a held ticker missing a session three ways before this file matters: it re-fetches direct from Yahoo in case the payload was degraded, it reconstructs the session from intraday prints where they exist (bar tagged r:true, published in meta.recoveredBars), and it confirms a genuine non-trading day where the counter had no prints while its exchange was open. Only a gap that survives all three stops the bake, because at that point there is no honest number to publish and the name is withdrawn from the day cards. Record such a gap here, after establishing by hand what happened on the date, to clear the latch. An entry here is read by later sessions as verified fact, so a careless one is worse than the stop it clears. Entries are kept once inert, as a record of how often and how badly the feed fails.

acknowledged.status: superseded — now auto-recovered from intraday prints
acknowledged.verified: 5m series shows a full session, 1,886,931 shares, reconstructed close 5.860
acknowledged.note: Yahoo daily series returned a null bar for a real SGX session and a fabricated flat bar on the 10 Aug National Day holiday. Gap persists across every range and both query hosts. This was the incident that prompted the audit: it misplaced S$4,169 between the Intraday and 1-Day cards and showed ES3 as the day's largest contributor when it was down 0.24% on the session.
